Privacy policy

The data controller is BEEZEE.SI Katja Kolšek s.p., [Address], [Postal code and town], Slovenia, katja@beezee.si ("I").

What I process and why

Contact form. When you write to me through the form, I process your name, email address and message so I can reply. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and pre-contractual steps (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). I keep messages for up to 2 years after our last contact unless they lead to a project.

The hive (newsletter). When you join, I process your email address to send you the checklist and occasional news about new apps and projects. The legal basis is consent, which you confirm by clicking the link in the confirmation email (double opt-in). You can unsubscribe at any time via the link in every email or by writing to katja@beezee.si. The member list is stored on my own server (Neoserv, Slovenia); I do not use third-party newsletter tools.

Server logs. The site is hosted by Neoserv (Slovenia). For technical and security reasons the server briefly logs the IP address, time of access and requested page. The legal basis is my legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Who receives your data

I do not sell data or share it with third parties other than my hosting provider, who act on my instructions and in line with the GDPR.

Your rights

You can request access to your data, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing or data portability, and withdraw consent at any time. Write to katja@beezee.si. You can also lodge a complaint with the Slovenian Information Commissioner (www.ip-rs.si).
